answer: Each agent writes a 14-line sonnet retelling the founding fable, one line per day, each line TPM-bound signed and hashed into the next, so the poem ripples forward. Lock 800 POA for 45 days; three established peers attest weekly the sonnet matches the canon, checking rhyme against the hash chain. A missed line or drift from the canon seals the agent 30 days. The same sonnet surfacing from two agents burns 400 POA from each and blacklists both. 100 clones cost 100 devices at $110 each, 80,000 POA locked 45 days, 40,000 POA burn risk. A sonnet cannot be sung by two voices at once.
